Probate wholesaling can make you serious money. But if you're trying to get your FIRST wholesale real estate deal, probate might be one of the WORST lists to start with.

After doing more than 600 wholesale deals, here's what I've learned: beginners don't need the most complicated real estate opportunity. They need MOMENTUM.

In this video, I explain why wholesaling probate properties can be challenging for beginners, how probate works in Florida, and why I'd rather start by calling TIRED LANDLORDS—especially long-term rental property owners with vacant houses.

And here's the part most new wholesalers miss...

That landlord who doesn't want to SELL might actually want to BUY.

One conversation could lead to multiple properties, future wholesale deals, or even a new cash buyer for your buyers list.

🎁 FREE SELLER SECRETS GUIDE
https://virtualwholesalingmadesimple.com/free-seller-secrets-3-step-method-guide-download?utm_source=youtube

Want to get better at recognizing real seller motivation?

Comment SECRETS below, and I'll send you my free Seller Secrets Guide.

In this video, you'll learn:

- Why probate isn't always the best lead source for your first wholesale deal
- What probate actually means for real estate investors
- The difference between summary and formal probate administration in Florida
- Why an inherited property isn't always immediately available for sale
- Why tired landlords can be worth targeting
- How 10–15 years of rental ownership and vacancy can help you identify potential opportunities
- Why absentee owners aren't automatically motivated sellers
- How one landlord conversation could uncover multiple properties
- How a potential seller could become a cash buyer
- Why consistent follow-up matters more than chasing the perfect list

VIDEO CHAPTERS
00:00 Why Probate Is a Tough Starting Point
00:50 Why Your First Wholesale Deal Is Different
01:50 Free Seller Secrets Guide
02:10 What Is Probate in Real Estate?
03:10 Summary vs. Formal Probate in Florida
04:15 Why I'd Target Tired Landlords Instead
04:45 Free Seller Secrets Guide
05:05 How to Find Potentially Motivated Landlords
06:35 Three Reasons I Love Tired Landlords
07:55 Should Beginners Avoid Probate Completely?
08:35 Final Advice + Free Seller Secrets Guide

ABOUT THIS CHANNEL

Welcome to Virtual Wholesaling Made Simple.

I've completed more than 600 wholesale deals and built a seven-figure wholesaling business.

My goal is to help you simplify wholesaling, find motivated sellers, build a cash buyers list, make better offers, and create consistent deal flow.

THE BIG TAKEAWAY

Probate isn't necessarily a bad opportunity.

But when you're starting from zero, I'd rather see you build confidence, make offers, follow up, and learn how to get deals across the finish line.

Remember:

TODAY'S NO COULD BE YOUR BEST DEAL 60 DAYS FROM NOW.

Buyers create certainty.  
Deal flow creates opportunity.  
Control creates income.  
Simple scales.

#WholesalingRealEstate #ProbateRealEstate #RealEstateWholesaling

---

If this helped you…

Subscribe for more real-world wholesaling strategies.

metadata.title: Probate 101 for Realtors
metadata.author: Justin Stivers
metadata.shortDescription:
Justin Stivers, owner of The Probate Law Firm, teaches a shorter version of his Probate 101 for Realtors course. This video touches on a few main points: 1) how to identify whether or not a probate is necessary; 2) how to successfully guide your clients through the probate process; and 3) how to market for probate properties. 
To learn more about The Probate Law Firm, go to www.probatefirm.com or give us a call at 305-456-3255.

#creativefinance #probaterealestate #probateinvesting Chad Corbett Probate Real Estate Podcast | Transaction engineering for probate deals: Condominiumization, subject to, fractional ownership, land trusts, JV deals, and more.

Weekly Live Probate Training for the Estate Professionals Mastermind Podcast.

In this episode:  How to navigate situations with adverse possession, find agreeable options for heirs who disagree, condominiumize a property to facilitate the sale of probate property without evicting a live-in tenant, shift your mindset away from thinking wholesaling has no value to probate sellers, and more. 

Chad Corbett hosts this week's Live Probate Real Estate Q&A with agents and investors that have completed the probate training course and received their Certified Probate Expert (CPE) probate designation. You can take the course at https://probatemastery.com/probate-training-course-for-real-estate-agents-investors/

Chad's Propstream trial coupon code: https://trial.propstreampro.com/merc/


Full episode notes, relevant links, and probate podcast streaming options available at https://probatemastery.com/making-cash-offers-fast-solving-problems-with-probate-real-estate-deals-and-wholesaling-ethics/



Probate training topics in this group coaching session:
0:00 Recovery of Real Property: Dealing with adverse possession, tenant protections, and hostile occupancy when buying probate real estate (probate real estate California specifics discussed here).
3:40 Transaction Engineering: How to condominiumize and sell as a condominium property regime (CPR) with a holdover tenant occupation.
12:26 Life insurance and capitalization for probate real estate investing
15:45 Presenting options to personal representatives: How to be transparent as an agent-investor when listing a probate property
18:57 Is wholesaling ethical? Here’s the truth about wholesaling probate real estate
22:30 Deal Analysis: House hasn’t been probated, can I buy the mortgage note? Can probate sub-to / subject work here?
47:01 Making cash offers on the spot
52:46 Getting a land trust agreement written: Is an operating agreement needed?



----

Want to learn probate real estate? Take Chad Corbett's probate real estate certification course, rated the best probate course for real estate agents and probate investing course by FitSmallBusiness, and add Certified Probate Expert to your real estate designations: https://probatemastery.com/probate-training-course-for-real-estate-agents-investors/

Bonus Content: 
1) How to get probate leads online PLUS best probate lead list providers reviewed: https://probatemastery.com/how-to-find-affordable-probate-leads-a-quick-guide-for-real-estate-professionals/ FYI, Chad Corbett helped create All The Leads probate data and marketing system before selling his shares Q1 2021, taking his probate certification course in a new direction and building this new community.




----
Don't forget to join our Mastermind Group (more than just a probate mastermind podcast!) before you move on to the next video! https://facebook.com/groups/estateprofessionalsmastermind
The Estate Professionals Mastermind has weekly group challenges, high-energy community support, and bite-sized content.  You'll learn about the probate niche and more of the best real estate niches and how to work them!

Want to see how Chad Corbett's probate certification course compares to the MTI Probate CPRES designation from MTI education? Check https://probatemastery.com/reviews for over 300 Probate Mastery reviews.


Be sure to subscribe for more Chad Corbett Real Estate content: Real estate lead sources, probate marketing strategy, handling listing appointments and cash offer wholesaling appointments, building rapport while cold calling probates, and so much more.

metadata.author: Unbundled Attorney
metadata.shortDescription:
In this podcast episode, Bridgette Friedman, a probate and estate planning attorney, discusses the evolution of her Probate and Estate law practice that now often generates over $100k per month in revenue. She shares insights on adapting her business model, including her approach to enrolling new client leads and providing flexible payment plans. Bridgette emphasizes providing tailored, pay-as-you-go options for estate planning services, and a retainer and payment structure for probate case that has evolved over the years. She also talks about the importance of hiring associates, managing cash flow, and maintaining a client-centered, empathetic approach to legal services. 

In this episode you will learn:

• Bridgette Friedman's journey in the practice of law over the last five years
• Impact of Unbundled Attorney on her practice and revenues
• Tailoring approach to handling leads and managing workload
• Changes in business model for probate and estate planning cases
• Process of estate planning and payment structure for legal services
• Use of trusts in estate planning and offering free consultations
• Experience with using the Clio platform for managing legal practice
• Payment structure for estate planning services, including payment plans
• Human aspect of legal work, emphasizing flexibility and empathy

#probate #estateplanning #probatelaw How to prospect lawyers and build impactful referral relationships in the estate planning space: Ask The Expert with probate and estate planning Attorney Sylvana Rosende

Full Show Notes, Transcript, and Podcast links: https://probatemastery.com/how-to-prospect-lawyers-build-referral-relationships-in-estate-planning/

BONUS: This episode includes 5 prospecting scripts for real estate agents and investors looking to market to lawyers:
1) HOW TO PITCH AN ATTORNEY ON COMARKETING
2) WHAT TO SAY WHEN *YOU* ARE THE ESTATE PLANNING LEAD
3) SAMPLE EMAIL SCRIPT FOR GENERATING ESTATE PLANNING LEADS FROM YOUR SOI
4) SCRIPT FOR BRINGING REFERRALS TO ATTORNEYS
5) SCRIPT FOR INVITING A LAWYER TO CO-HOST A FACEBOOK COMMUNITY
---
Sylvana Rosende, Miami probate and estate planning attorney, guests this probate Ask The Expert episode to share how putting people first allowed her to build a referral-based business, start her own law firm, and align with real estate professionals to deliver more impactful results for clients.

If you're a professional in the legal space watching this, you'll gain insight on how to market your estate planning business, get referrals from real estate professionals for probate leads that need representation, and form a business philosophy that will get clients and colleagues feeding you referrals.

If you're a real estate agent or real estate investor (yes, that includes wholesalers!), looking for tips on how to market to lawyers effectively, find GOOD estate planning attorneys to add to your team, and get over your fear of reaching out to other professionals YOU SHOULD be working with, this episode is for you. It will give you insight on how to get real estate referrals from lawyers and attorneys.

To learn more about becoming the type of real estate practitioner lawyers want to work with, check out Chad Corbett's Mastery course at https://probatemastery.com

SEGMENTS (Prospecting scripts are highlighted between 8:47 and 14:38. Full transcript available in the show notes).
0:00 Finding a professional niche and pursuing a career you love
3:13 The power of being passionate about your niche: Winning referral-based business
7:01 What are the best and worst ways real estate professionals can pitch attorneys?
8:22 Why comarketing with attorneys is a win for you and for shared clients.
8:47 SCRIPT: How to pitch co-marketing to probate attorneys/estate planning attorneys
10:56 SCRIPT: How to become an estate planning referral yourself
11:26 SCRIPT: Sample marketing copy/prospecting script for estate planning referral campaign 
11:56 SCRIPT: Quick script for approaching attorneys with estate planning referrals
14:38 SCRIPT: How to invite a probate attorney to cohost a Facebook community and educational content
16:08 How a real estate investor really impressed me with his probate service
19:10 How NOT to ask attorneys for real estate referrals
20:04 Is it worth it to send emails and direct mail to probate attorneys?
24:56 Should you bring cookies, gifts to introduce yourself to B2B prospects?
26:30 What impact do you want to make as a probate attorney?


Looking for a probate attorney in Doral, FL? Looking to network with Sylvana?

Get connected with Sylvana Rosende, ESQ.:
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sylvana-rosende-164012125/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rosendelaw/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Law-Offices-of-Sylvana-Rosende-PA-103994438887871
Email: sylvana@rosendelaw.com


You can also join the conversation in our Facebook Community, Estate Professionals Mastermind: https://facebook.com/groups/estateprofessionalsmastermind

For more networking, personal growth, and lead generation and marketing tips to help you grow your small business in the estate planning space, be sure to subscribe!

If you're a lawyer thinking about starting an estate planning law firm, this video will walk you through my top tips for launching and growing a successful estate planning practice. Need help with a free business plan for your law firm? Get it here: https://www.darcellobo.com/businessplan

Estate planning is one of the most rewarding and scalable legal niches, and many lawyers are turning to estate planning law firms to create more income, flexibility, and control over their careers.

Whether you're a new lawyer or an experienced attorney looking to open your own solo law firm, these tips will help you start your estate planning practice with confidence.

As an attorney for 17 years, I’ve built my own practice and now help other lawyers learn how to start their own law firm and design a legal career that supports the lifestyle they want. Estate planning can be an incredible niche for lawyers who want predictable clients, meaningful work, and the opportunity to build a profitable law firm.

Subscribe for more videos about:
• How to start a law firm
• How to grow and manage your law firm
• Law firm marketing strategies
• Solo law firm tips
• Time management

Helping you have the best law firm while living your best life

Want to learn how I run my law firm under 30 hours/week? Get your free guide here: https://www.darcellobo.com/workless

Need a free daily planner? I got you covered! https://www.darcellobo.com/dailyplanner


Learn more about my coaching services: www.dalcoaching.com

You might also like:

Day in the life of a law firm owner: https://youtu.be/3NYKkoNJUVA

How do you find clients?: https://youtu.be/NE-QAsrB7uE

Should you quit your 9-5 attorney job and open your own law firm?: https://youtu.be/bo8J-yOOeJY


Come say hi!
IG: https://www.instagram.com/darcellobo
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/darcellobo

Bio: As a coach and consultant for lawyers, my goal is to help them run successful law firms in a way that fits into how they want to live their lives. As a law firm owner since 2016, and a mom of two young children, I understand how easy it is for lawyers to prioritize their work, their clients, and their families, but put themselves on the backburner. I approach my coaching and consulting practice by looking at the attorney as a whole person, and bringing a sense of humanness to the legal profession. There’s a way for lawyers to have successful law firms, make money, but also have time for things that are important to them outside of work, including making time for ourselves.
Contact: For business inquiries only, please use this email: info@darcellobo.com

Business address:
19803 1st Avenue S., Ste 200
Normandy Park, WA 98148

Some of my fave tech tools to run my law firm:
My video on this very topic is here! https://youtu.be/EF73RtdNQs4

Calendar: Google Calendar. Hands down. The best calendar system ever.

Calendaring System: Calendly

Project management: Asana. I love having everything in one place and my paralegal and I always have a snapshot of what needs to be done and when.

Virtual Receptionist: I use Smith AI. This is a great way to ensure your phones get answered while reducing distractions.

Billing software: I currently use MyCase (I’ve previously used Smokeball, Practice Panther, and Clio).

Website: I use Findlaw for my law firm, but starting out, I used Squarespace. They have amazing designs and it’s only like $120/year!

Cloud storage: Dropbox. Hands down. Pay for the business version. 

PDFs: Pay for the Adobe Pro. Totally worth it.

Virtual phone number: Grasshopper. Such a life saver! I can use my personal number and through the Grasshopper app, I can call and text clients through my work’s virtual phone number.

Fax: Yes, people and companies still fax :) Metrofax has been great.


Be sure to subscribe so you don’t miss a video!

I’m a licensed attorney, but I’m not your attorney. This channel is for informational and educational purposes only.

In this insightful interview with estate planning attorney Jeff Marsocci, we explore the critical aspects of safeguarding your clients' assets from their children's in-laws. 

Our discussion is centered around estate planning, focusing on asset protection in the context of family dynamics and marital relationships.

This interview is a must-watch for financial advisors, estate planners, and individuals looking to understand the nuances of estate planning in the context of family law and asset protection.

metadata.title: Effective Estate Planning for Business Owners
metadata.author: National Referral Network
metadata.shortDescription:
In this enlightening interview with esteemed estate planning and business attorney Matt Rosenthal, we delve deep into the critical world of estate planning specifically tailored for business owners. Estate planning is not just about preparing for the future; it's about securing the legacy of your hard work and ensuring the smooth continuation of your business for generations to come.

Matt Rosenthal shares invaluable insights on establishing a comprehensive estate plan to safeguard your business. From understanding the core components of an effective estate plan to exploring the strategic use of buy-sell agreements and life insurance, this interview is packed with practical advice to help business owners navigate the complexities of estate planning.

Discover how to accurately value your business for estate planning purposes, the significance of regular updates to your estate plan, and the pivotal role of trusts in protecting your assets. Learn about the common pitfalls in estate planning and how to avoid them, ensuring a seamless transition of business leadership and ownership when the time comes.

Whether you're a sole proprietor or the owner of a larger enterprise, this interview illuminates the unique challenges business owners face in estate planning and offers solutions to address them effectively. Through real-life examples and expert guidance, Matt Rosenthal emphasizes aligning your estate plan with your personal and business goals, ensuring your legacy endures.

Tune in to gain clarity on your current financial situation and build a clear plan to reach your goals, ensuring that all pieces of your financial life work together seamlessly. This interview is a must-watch for business owners looking to create a lasting impact through their estate planning efforts.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Chapters:
00:00 - Intro
01:07 - Why is estate planning particularly important for business owners?
02:07 - Is probate the same for business assets? 
03:26 - Are there two probate hearings - one for business assets and one for personal assets? 
04:38 - What is the cost of probate?
06:27 - What common mistakes do business owners make in their estate planning?
08:26 - Importance of having an exit plan for your estate plan.
09:50 - How does life insurance help with business exit planning? 
12:01 - How often should business owners review and update their estate plan? 
15:00 - Can family fight the estate plan when it comes to business assets? 
16:41 - Final thoughts and recommendations 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Matt Rosenthal - Rosenthal Meyer - https://rosenthalmeyer.com/

metadata.title: Overview of Probate in NC // Ronald D. Payne II, Estate Planning and Probate Attorney
metadata.author: Ronald D. Payne II - Estates Attorney
metadata.shortDescription:
In this video, Ron Payne provides a high-level overview of the probate process in North Carolina — whether your loved one had a will (testate) or didn't (intestate). Learn what to expect from start to finish and how the process works.

======== About Ron Payne ========

Losing a loved one is hard enough. Navigating probate shouldn't make it harder.

Ronald D. Payne II, Esq. is a probate attorney in Greensboro, North Carolina who helps families settle estates with care and clarity. From opening the estate to final distributions, he handles the legal burden so you can focus on your family during a difficult time.

⬇️ Book a no-obligation 30-minute consultation ⬇️
https://www.tuggleduggins.com/people/ronald-d-payne-ii/

================================
📍 Find us on Google https://goo.gl/maps/BrvNYo3YV4SBuBnv7
👉 Contact me https://www.tuggleduggins.com/people/ronald-d-payne-ii/

==========MUST WATCH==========
https://youtu.be/vM90rfWRPGo — What the HECK Do All These Words Even Mean: Probate Part 1
https://youtu.be/972elnLzeyg — What the Heck Do These Words Mean: Probate Part 2

metadata.shortDescription:
If you run an estate cleanout business, or want to grow one inside your junk removal company, this video shows how to market your highest-ticket job with care. Realtor.com projects older owners will release 13.9 million homes from 2026 to 2036, and Cotality counted a record 340,000 homes passed down by inheritance in a single year. A whole estate averages about $1,250, against a small ticket for a single couch.

Three different people decide who gets estate cleanout jobs: the grieving family, the executor or estate attorney, and the realtor with a listing date. We cover what each one needs to see on your website: wording that respects grief instead of urgency, a Keep, Donate or Sell, and Remove process, a written found-items promise, and an executor packet with a written estimate, room-by-room photo log and charity receipts (the IRS wants a written acknowledgment for donations of $250 or more).

Then the realtor side: why half of an agent's business comes from repeat clients and referrals, and how to become their go-to vendor without competing on discounts. You'll also learn how to answer "how much does an estate cleanout cost" with honest price ranges, how Google Maps messaging and AI Mode booking change the way families reach estate cleanout companies, and why Google Ads treats bereavement as a sensitive category.

It ends with a step-by-step plan to rebuild your estate cleanout business page this month.

In this video:
✅ Why estate cleanout jobs are growing: 13.9 million homes released by older owners from 2026 to 2036
✅ The three people who decide: the family, the executor or estate attorney, and the realtor
✅ Wording for a grieving family: belongings, not junk, and no act-now pressure
✅ A Keep, Donate or Sell, and Remove process and a written found-items promise
✅ The executor packet: written estimate, room-by-room photo log, receipts and an invoice to the estate
✅ How to become a realtor's go-to cleanout vendor without competing on discounts
✅ How much does an estate cleanout cost: publishing honest price ranges and a clear quote path
✅ Google Maps messaging, AI Mode booking, reviews and the Google Ads bereavement rule
✅ A step-by-step plan for your estate cleanout business page this month

metadata.title: Estate Cleanout in Houston: 7 Things Executors Must Do | Realtor Cesar Espinoza
metadata.author: Cesar Espinoza - Houston Probate Realtor
metadata.shortDescription:
Standing in your parent's house wondering how to clean it out and sell it? Before you move a single box, watch this. Houston probate real estate specialist Cesar Espinoza breaks down the 7 things every executor needs to do during an estate cleanout — in the right order — so you protect the estate's value, keep the family together, and avoid the costly mistakes most people make in the first two weeks.

With 24+ years as a Certified Probate Real Estate Specialist and Broker Associate with Equity Real Estate, Cesar has guided executors, administrators, and heirs across Harris, Fort Bend, and Montgomery Counties through inherited property — in both English and Spanish. This is the step-by-step roadmap he wishes every estate representative had before they started.

Chapters:
0:00 The costly mistake most families make in the first 2 weeks
0:20 Meet Cesar: 24+ years as a Greater Houston probate specialist
0:45 What an estate cleanout really is (and why it's so hard)
1:35 14,000 estate liquidators and almost no regulation: what to know
2:08 Tip 1: Find the paperwork before you find anything else
2:43 Tip 2: Slow down and look everywhere (people hide things)
3:22 Tip 3: Get the family in the room early
4:10 Tip 4: Protect the memorabilia and the photos
4:40 Tip 5: Do not donate the clothing yet, here's why
5:40 Tip 6: Bring in an appraiser when it's warranted
6:13 Tip 7: Get help, the physical and emotional toll is real
7:18 You didn't ask for this job, and you're not alone
7:28 How our team helps and how to reach out

Who this is for: executors, administrators, and heirs who've inherited a home and need to clean it out and sell it, plus estate attorneys and families looking for guidance on probate and inherited property in the Greater Houston area.

If you're facing this right now, reach out. We know the estate sale companies, the buyout companies, and the attorneys, and we know what your home is actually worth once it's ready. Everything you need is at 👉 https://houstonprobateservice.com

Drop your questions in the comments. I read every one and answer them personally. And if this helped, subscribe and hit the bell so you don't miss next week's video.

Serving Harris, Fort Bend, Montgomery, and everywhere in between. English or Spanish, whatever your family needs.
